about: How a cause group founded in the simulation is named when a screen or story says it (data/english, read by src/english/group-names.ts). A form is filled with the group's topic as a sentence says it mid-line; the form is picked by a fixed reading of the group's key so a group keeps one name. Replaces SG-P10-group-name-key. A form's `plural` says whether the name takes a plural verb ("Friends of ... back", "Coalition for ... backs").
